page.notes: The stroke over "párere" in "uentum párere quid 277" is transcribed without the accent, as it may be ink or a mark rather than a printed accent. The large initial "V" of "Aletudine" is read as "Valetudine". Several small handwritten marks in the margins (left and right) and ink specks below the text are not printed and are omitted. "tractatio" in "uerbi contemptus 322 suc-cessus 542 trastatio" and "tet in" in "oportet in rebus" are read from ligatures and may need checking. No page number is printed.
